title: AI Movies Flop in Theaters, Even as AI Videos Flood Phones
summary: Videos made by AI are everywhere in China. A recent report suggests nearly two-thirds of the microdramas in China are all made by AI. But people seem to draw a line between free videos on their phones and movies they pay to see in a theater. The fully AI-generated movie Sanxingdui: Future Past flopped at the Chinese box office, showing AI still has a hard road ahead in theaters. The film was not a one-click project. Producer Bona says it took two years and a team of 70 to 80 people to make, and it was still being changed a week before it reached theaters. Still, an attendee told the international outlet AFP that the AI falls short of a human-made, live-action movie. A 100-minute movie must also pass a content review before theaters. The next test is Gossip Goblin's fully AI movie, Gods Don't Give Gifts, opening in U.S. theaters this December. It is the first such movie to receive a rating from the MPA, and it hopes to be considered for Best Animated Feature at the Oscars.
why_it_matters: It matters when you watch videos on your phone because it shows why a fun free clip and a movie ticket are judged in very different ways.
